source.name: Columbus Crew – 'Columbus Crew launch "The Crafted for Excellence Kit" ahead of 2026 season'
source.quote: The front and center of the kit proudly feature the Club’s official jersey sponsor, Nationwide. DHL Supply Chain returns in 2026 as the Club’s official right sleeve partner.
source.note: Club's own kit-launch announcement. For Soccer's 2026 MLS jersey-sponsor roundup (https://www.forsoccer.com/insight/2026-mls-jersey-sponsors/) lists the same placements: Nationwide front, DHL right sleeve, Apple TV left sleeve.

source.name: Columbus Crew – 'Columbus Crew launch "The Crafted for Excellence Kit" ahead of 2026 season'
source.quote: The front and center of the kit proudly feature the Club’s official jersey sponsor, Nationwide. DHL Supply Chain returns in 2026 as the Club’s official right sleeve partner.
source.note: DHL Supply Chain is the right-sleeve partner; the Apple TV league patch is on the left sleeve.

source.name: SportsLogos.Net: 'MLS to Allow Back-of-Jersey Ads Starting After 2026 All-Star Break'
source.quote: All 30 MLS clubs feature the Apple TV+ logo on the left sleeve patch as part of a league-wide deal.
source.note: League-wide patch; For Soccer's 2026 roundup also lists Apple TV on the Columbus Crew left sleeve.

summary: The Crafted for Excellence Kit, the adidas home jersey launched 10 February 2026 with a collar and coral and teal accents. Nationwide is on the front; DHL Supply Chain returns as the right-sleeve partner; the league-wide Apple TV+ patch is on the left sleeve of every MLS kit. MLS only opens back-of-jersey ad space after the 2026 All-Star Break, and no Crew back sponsor has been announced.
